description: Analytics workload over the pqgen datasets (stand-in for benchmarks/workloads/analytics.json, which is not part of the workspace). Tables are loaded from CSV under their file names; queries run with default options and full results.

queries.name: q01_filter_count
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions WHERE amount > 500 AND status = 'approved'

queries.name: q02_agg_category
queries.sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(amount) AS total, AVG(fee) AS avg_fee, MIN(ts) AS first_ts, MAX(merchant_id) AS max_merchant FROM transactions GROUP BY category ORDER BY category

queries.name: q03_agg_customer_top
queries.sql: SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(amount) AS total FROM transactions GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY total DESC, customer_id LIMIT 20

queries.name: q04_agg_customer_all
queries.sql: SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(amount) AS total FROM transactions GROUP BY customer_id

queries.name: q05_having
queries.sql: SELECT merchant_id, COUNT(*) AS n, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount FROM transactions WHERE status = 'approved' GROUP BY merchant_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 35 ORDER BY n DESC, merchant_id

queries.name: q06_monthly
queries.sql: SELECT YEAR(ts) AS y, MONTH(ts) AS m, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(amount) AS total FROM transactions GROUP BY YEAR(ts), MONTH(ts) ORDER BY y, m

queries.name: q07_date_trunc
queries.sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', ts) AS month, category, SUM(fee) AS fees FROM transactions WHERE is_fraud = FALSE GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', ts), category ORDER BY month, category

queries.name: q08_case_buckets
queries.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN amount < 50 THEN 'small' WHEN amount < 500 THEN 'medium' ELSE 'large' END AS size, status, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(amount) AS total FROM transactions GROUP BY CASE WHEN amount < 50 THEN 'small' WHEN amount < 500 THEN 'medium' ELSE 'large' END, status ORDER BY size, status

queries.name: q09_conditional_sum
queries.sql: SELECT category, SUM(CASE WHEN is_fraud THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS fraud_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'declined' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS declined FROM transactions GROUP BY category ORDER BY category

queries.name: q10_count_distinct
queries.sql: SELECT category, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customers, COUNT(DISTINCT merchant_id) AS merchants FROM transactions GROUP BY category ORDER BY category

queries.name: q11_join_segment
queries.sql: SELECT c.segment, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(t.amount) AS total FROM transactions t JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY c.segment

queries.name: q12_join_country_top
queries.sql: SELECT c.country, SUM(t.amount) AS total, COUNT(*) AS n FROM transactions t JOIN customers c ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE t.status = 'approved' AND c.is_active GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 10

queries.name: q13_join_items_orders
queries.sql: SELECT o.status, SUM(i.quantity) AS qty, SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) AS revenue, COUNT(*) AS n FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id GROUP BY o.status ORDER BY o.status

queries.name: q14_join3_category
queries.sql: SELECT p.category, COUNT(*) AS lines, SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) AS revenue FROM order_items i JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY revenue DESC

queries.name: q15_join4_segment_brand
queries.sql: SELECT c.segment, p.brand, SUM(i.quantity) AS qty FROM order_items i, orders o, customers c, products p WHERE i.order_id = o.order_id AND o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND i.product_id = p.product_id AND o.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' GROUP BY c.segment, p.brand ORDER BY c.segment, qty DESC

queries.name: q16_left_join_no_orders
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_id IS NULL

queries.name: q17_in_subquery
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(amount) FROM transactions WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM customers WHERE segment = 'enterprise' AND is_active)

queries.name: q18_scalar_subquery
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions WHERE amount > (SELECT AVG(amount) * 3 FROM transactions)

queries.name: q19_exists
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND o.status = 'paid')

queries.name: q20_cte
queries.sql: WITH spend AS (SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS total FROM transactions GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT c.segment, COUNT(*) AS customers, AVG(s.total) AS avg_total, MAX(s.total) AS max_total FROM spend s JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY c.segment

queries.name: q21_derived_table
queries.sql: SELECT b, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) / 5 AS b FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id) d GROUP BY b ORDER BY b

queries.name: q22_topn
queries.sql: SELECT tx_id, customer_id, amount, ts FROM transactions ORDER BY amount DESC, tx_id LIMIT 100

queries.name: q23_sort_rows
queries.sql: SELECT tx_id, amount, category FROM transactions WHERE merchant_id < 100 ORDER BY amount, tx_id

queries.name: q24_like
queries.sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE email LIKE '%@example.com' AND name LIKE 'A%' GROUP BY country ORDER BY country

queries.name: q25_string_funcs
queries.sql: SELECT UPPER(SUBSTR(name, 1, 3)) AS prefix, COUNT(*) AS n FROM products GROUP BY UPPER(SUBSTR(name, 1, 3)) ORDER BY n DESC, prefix LIMIT 20

queries.name: q26_sensor_agg
queries.sql: SELECT sensor_id, AVG(temperature) AS avg_t, MAX(humidity) AS max_h, MIN(pressure) AS min_p FROM sensor_readings WHERE status = 'ok' GROUP BY sensor_id ORDER BY sensor_id

queries.name: q27_sensor_hourly
queries.sql: SELECT HOUR(ts) AS h, COUNT(*) AS n, AVG(temperature) AS avg_t, MAX(temperature) - MIN(temperature) AS spread FROM sensor_readings GROUP BY HOUR(ts) ORDER BY h

queries.name: q28_nulls
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(n50), SUM(n90), MIN(d99), MAX(f95), COUNT(*) AS n FROM nulls_heavy WHERE n50 IS NOT NULL OR b60

queries.name: q29_coalesce
queries.sql: SELECT COALESCE(s70, 'none') AS s, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(COALESCE(n50, 0)) AS total FROM nulls_heavy GROUP BY COALESCE(s70, 'none') ORDER BY s

queries.name: q30_sort_strings
queries.sql: SELECT str_key, COUNT(*) AS n FROM sort_keys GROUP BY str_key ORDER BY n DESC, str_key LIMIT 50

queries.name: q31_distinct
queries.sql: SELECT DISTINCT merchant_id FROM transactions

queries.name: q32_window_like_rank
queries.sql: SELECT o.customer_id, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(o.item_count) AS items FROM orders o WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-06-30' GROUP BY o.customer_id ORDER BY items DESC, o.customer_id LIMIT 25

queries.name: q33_union_all
queries.sql: SELECT 'tx' AS src, COUNT(*) AS n FROM transactions WHERE is_fraud UNION ALL SELECT 'orders', COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled'

queries.name: q34_wide_result
queries.sql: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid'
